stem:
The table shows the amount of time eight thunderstorms lasted and the amount of rainfall each thunderstorm produced.

Thunderstorm Data

| Amount of Time, x (hours) | 1 | 2 | 3 | 2 | 1 | 4 | 3 | 2 |
| Amount of Rainfall, y (inches) | 5 | 8 | 11 | 6 | 4 | 14 | 8 | 10 |

Which scatterplot best represents the data?

options.label: C
options.text: Scatterplot with points grouped tighter near x=2 with y values 4 to 14, points approximately at (1,5), (2,6), (3,10), (2,8), (1,4), (4,14), (3,11), (2,12)

options.label: D
options.text: Scatterplot with points scattered less according to given data approx at (1,4), (2,6), (3,8), (2,10), (1,5), (4,14), (3,11), (2,12)
